---
title: "Analyzing US Births"
author: "Eliza"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
births <- read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx")
glimpse(births)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
births_tibble <- read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx") |>
  mutate(
    day_of_week = factor(
      day_of_week,
      levels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thurs", "Fri", "Sat"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
births_by_calendar_day <- births_tibble |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarize(avg_births = mean(births), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(births_by_calendar_day, aes(x = date_of_month, y = month, fill = avg_births)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = 1:12, labels = month.name) +
  labs(x = "Day of month", y = "Month", fill = "Mean births")
```

```{r}
christmas_births <- births_tibble |>
  filter(month == 12, date_of_month %in% c(20:25, 27:30)) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(
    dec_25_births = sum(births[date_of_month == 25]),
    surrounding_avg = mean(births[date_of_month != 25]),
    pct_of_baseline = 100 * dec_25_births / surrounding_avg,
    christmas_weekday = day_of_week[date_of_month == 25][1],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

christmas_births

ggplot(christmas_births, aes(x = year, y = pct_of_baseline)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(color = christmas_weekday)) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "December 25 births (% of baseline)",
    color = "Weekday"
  )
```

```{r}
births_model <- lm(births ~ year + month + day_of_week, data = births_tibble)
summary(births_model)$r.squared
```

```{r}
births_adjusted <- births_tibble |>
  mutate(pct_resid = 100 * resid(births_model) / mean(births))

calendar_resid <- births_adjusted |>
  filter(!(month == 2 & date_of_month == 29)) |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarize(mean_pct_resid = mean(pct_resid), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(calendar_date = as.Date(sprintf("2001-%02d-%02d", month, date_of_month))) |>
  arrange(calendar_date)

calendar_resid

holiday_labels <- calendar_resid |>
  filter(
    (month == 12 & date_of_month %in% c(24, 25)) |
      (month == 1 & date_of_month == 1)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    holiday = case_when(
      month == 12 & date_of_month == 24 ~ "Christmas Eve",
      month == 12 & date_of_month == 25 ~ "Christmas Day",
      TRUE ~ "New Year's Day"
    ),
    label_date = calendar_date + case_when(
      month == 12 & date_of_month == 24 ~ -7,
      month == 12 & date_of_month == 25 ~ 7,
      TRUE ~ 7
    ),
    label_y = mean_pct_resid - 3
  )

ggplot(calendar_resid, aes(x = calendar_date, y = mean_pct_resid)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray60") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_segment(
    data = holiday_labels,
    aes(x = calendar_date, xend = label_date, y = mean_pct_resid, yend = label_y),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "gray40"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = holiday_labels,
    aes(x = label_date, y = label_y, label = holiday),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(x = "Calendar date", y = "Mean residual (% of overall mean births)")
```
